# MCP Builder Kit
> Production Toolkit & Scaffolding Engine for Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers

MCP Builder Kit enables software teams to scaffold, develop, inspect, audit, and package production Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in TypeScript and Python (FastMCP).

Website: https://mcp.ritualdev.in/
Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/mcp-builder-kit
Developer Wiki: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/mcp-builder-kit/wiki
Ecosystem Hub: https://devshelf.ritualdev.in/
License: Apache-2.0
Developer Contact: developer@ritualdev.in
Support: support@ritualdev.in
Enterprise Inquiries: contact@ritualdev.in

## Quick Start CLI
```bash
# Scaffold a TypeScript MCP server
npx @ritualdev-lab/mcp-builder-kit init my-tools-server

# Scaffold a Python FastMCP server
npx @ritualdev-lab/mcp-builder-kit init my-tools-server --lang python

# Generate typed tool code with Zod schema
npx @ritualdev-lab/mcp-builder-kit add-tool search_knowledge --desc "Vector search" --params "query:string,limit:number"

# Convert OpenAPI / Swagger spec into MCP tools
npx @ritualdev-lab/mcp-builder-kit from-openapi ./petstore.json --lang typescript

# Run headless protocol conformance inspection
npx @ritualdev-lab/mcp-builder-kit inspect "node dist/index.js"

# Pre-flight AgentShield Zero-Leak security audit
npx @ritualdev-lab/mcp-builder-kit audit ./src

# 1-Click packaging & containerization (Docker, Claude Desktop, Cursor)
npx @ritualdev-lab/mcp-builder-kit package ./my-server --lang typescript --port 8080 --env "OPENAI_API_KEY,DB_HOST"
```

## Core Features & Primitives
- **Dual Language Engine**: Native scaffolding for TypeScript (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk + Zod + tsup) and Python (FastMCP + Pydantic v2).
- **Dual Transports**: stdio for local agent execution (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity) and sse / streamable HTTP for remote containerized environments.
- **OpenAPI to MCP Compiler**: Ingests Swagger/OpenAPI specifications, resolves $ref schemas, and produces typed MCP tool handlers.
- **Headless Conformance Inspector**: Automates full JSON-RPC handshakes, tool listing discovery, and latency measurement in CI/CD pipelines.
- **AgentShield Zero-Leak Auditor**: AST and adaptive Shannon entropy scanning (detecting API keys, private keys, command injections, and path traversals) with drop-in parameter sanitizers.
- **1-Click Packaging**: Generates multi-stage Dockerfiles, Claude Desktop config snippets, Cursor configs, and mcp.json registry manifests.
